Being within nature......
Waipu Caves Farm Park
567 Waipu Caves Rd, Waipu,
New Zealand, Phone 09 430 27 22, waipucaves@gmail.com
Waipu Caves Farm Park is a privately owned conservation and recreation park. The jewel of the park and a major jewel of the Northland Region is the Milky Way Glowworm Cave. Kept secret for more than 100 years it was opened in 2023 and is now considered one of the best glowworm caves in New Zealand. A richly biodiverse native forest filled with karst limestone rocks with clear streams flowing down the valley past camp grounds. Come as a day visitor or stay in your motorhome, caravan or tent.

Supporting Northland Land SAR (Search and Rescue) and Police SAR.
Search and Rescue happens in NZ with the use of both the Police and the volunteers of Land SAR.
For some years Ian Fox (owner of Waipu Caves Farm Park) has been involved in Northland Land SAR, particularly in cave rescue.
Fr om 2019 until June 2023 he was coordinator of training the cave rescue team, mostly using the various caves on the property.
In addition the Police SAR team also use Waipu Caves Farm Park 320 acre property for various training events.
With Ian stepping aside from actively coordinating training, he and Waipu Caves Farm Park still support the Northland Land SAR team and the Police SAR team with the free use of the property for training for various rescue scenario's and skills training by utilising the natural environments of caves, cliffs, bush and river along with the infrastructure of the campground, buildings, bush tracks, farm roads and paddocks etc.
Please visit their website ( her e ) and support by donating on the Northland Land SAR give a little page ( here ) or click on the logos below.

Stay | My Site
top of page
Stay here at Waipu Caves Farm Park
Tent sites and Motorhome sites available spread over 3 different area.
Book Your Stay
Map and photos
We opened the camp in 2023 and there is some construction still being done in some areas. Some of our buildings are temporary portacoms which will be replaced with permanent buildings over the next few years. ​
​
Our camp ground.
​We are in a sheltered forested valley away from the coast. A small rocky river flows through the valley and there are lots of limestone boulders and rocks as well as our cave. The campground is part of a privately owned conservation and recreation park. The camp is a dark skies area so we do not have lighting everywhere, so bring your torch.
We are also fully off grid for electricity and have our own solar power station.
We have 3 camping areas each comfortably handle about 75 people and have 30 sites each.
Camp area B is mostly tent sites and 3 non-powered vehicle sites There is a shared kitchen, toilets and showers.
There is a firepit with firewood supplied. The fire must not be used when
windy or during a fire ban and must be fully watered until dead each night a fter use.
Camp area C is mostly motorhome sites, some with power/electricity with shared kitchen, toilet and shower.
Camp area D has mostly tents sites and suits people with there own cookers etc. Shared toilet.
Our tent sites.
Tent sites are large 9m x 9m square or 9m x 8m (4 sites in area C).
TENT SITES are for TENTS ONLY so NO VEHICLES.
No vehicles can drive on these sites as there is a fence to stop them. This makes it safe for children.
Parking is close by the tents sites.
If you are a ROOF TENT VEHICLE you will need to book a motorhome site with a gravel base.
Our motorhome/vehicle sites.
All motorhome/vehicle sites have a gravel base. No vehicles are to park on grass.
Roof tents on vehicles are vehicles and not tents. These must be in motorhome/vehicle sites.
Most motorhome/vehicle sites are 8m x 6m some are as large as 12m x 5m.
We have 5 sites with power/electricity. and 18 with no power.
What to do here while staying.
​There is plenty to do here while on your stay. There are 2 different guided tour into the Milky Way Glowworm Cave. There are free things, such as bush walking, swimming in the river, bouldering, rock climbing, hut building, obstacle course and relaxing.
​
What to do nearby.
Our local area has lots of beaches, good for walking, swimming, surfing etc as well as cafes and restaurants, there are bush walks and art galleries and museums.
We are a Destination, not a Stop Over.
We provide a camping place for visitors to stay, spend the day, maybe several, visit our Milky Way Glowworm Cave, go bush walking, bouldering or rock climbing, swimming in the river, and much more, relax and have a break at our park.
We are NOT A STOP OVER.
This means if you are intending to arrive late and leave early the next day to go somewhere else without spending any time here, then we recommend you stay somewhere else that is more suited to your style of travel.
People who come late and leave early are disruptive to the people who want to stay and enjoy our park.
Gate and Office hours.
Peak Season - around Christmas and summer holidays 8am to 7pm.
Mid Season - Autumn and Spring 8am to 5pm.
Low Season - Winter 8.30am to 4pm.
When you book to stay you can come in and out through the gates.
Keep them shut to stop other people coming in.
​ ​ ​
Closed Days
The office is closed Christmas Day. If you have booked you can come in. Make sure you shut the gate. ​
Book Your Stay

Camp Fees
Tent sites and non-power motorhome sites.
First night $25 first adult, $20 extra adults, $15 per child (age 5-17) $0 per preschool (age 0-4).
7th night is free.
Powered motorhome sites.
First night $29 first adult, $24 extra adults, $19 per child (age 5-17) $0 per preschool (age 0-4).
7th night is free.
Hot showers use a $2 coin for 5 minutes, or free for cold.
Camp Rules
NO PETS which means NO DOGS or NO CATS anywhere on the property.
SMOKING or VAPING - Smoking tobacco/cigarettes or vaping is only permitted in your
own vehicle or tent and nowhere else.
DRUGS & ALCOHOL - No intoxicated behaviour.
VEHICLES - Don't drive or park on the grass tent sites as there is plenty of parking on gravel.
Don't drive past the sign which NO VISITOR VEHICLES BEYOND THIS POINT.
Speed limit is 10km/h (walking quickly speed) in the car park, in camp areas.
PARTIES - no parties unless you have booked the entire camp for this purpose.
NOISE - Quiet at 10pm to 8am. No loud music. Be considerate of others. NEW YEARS NIGHT (31st December)
tolerance of noise is extended to 1am but you must be considerate of others and keep volumes low.
​ MOTORHOME/CARAVAN WASTE WATER - Absolutely no chemical waste treatment chemicals into our septic system.
​ IF YOU ARE DISRUPTIVE AND CREATE A PROBLEM AND ARE TOLD TO LEAVE THERE ARE NO REFUNDS.

About | My Site
top of page
Waipu Caves Farm Park Being within natur e.......
Waipu Caves Farm Park is a privately owned conservation and recreation park opened in 2023. The jewel of the park and a major jewel of the Northland Region is the Milky Way Glowworm Cave. Kept secret for more than 100 years it was opened in February 2023 for public viewing as a walk-in show-cave. Considered one of the best glowworm caves in New Zealand with the largest amount of close up opportunity and educational experience with glowworms. In 2025 a second, deeper chamber in the cave was opened, named the Starburst Cathedral due to its size and beauty, it is a space where several music concerts are held over the drier months.
Over 200 acres of the land is covered in rich biodiverse native forest filled with karst limestones rocks covered in ferns and moss. Clear streams flow down the valley past campgrounds where people immerse themselves in the natural beauty, leisure and outdoor recreation.
School and youth camps are able to do a range of challenging activities such as rock climbing, bouldering, abseiling, bush walks, obstacle course and more.
Come as a day visitor or stay in your motorhome, caravan or tent.
You can have a guided cave tour or just relax or have an ice cream, chips, lollies, coffee and cold drinks from our small shop/office.
At Waipu Caves Farm Park, kids and adults connect within nature. There are trees to climb with rope swings and the river to explore and play in. There are rocks everywhere to climb on, bike on the farm roads and walk in the bush.
There is no TV room or wifi and minimal cell phone coverage.
About 100 acres is used for farming livestock.
The property is off grid with solar energy, providing power for the owners house, workshops and the entire camp infrastructure.
We look forward to having you visit.
​
Edited by Ian 04 May 2026

Cave Concert | My Site
top of page
Cave Concerts
Cave Concerts for summer 2026-2027.
​
October 31st - Saturday - Carina & Sam de Vetter a soulful indie duo. Albi & The Wolves a quirky pack providing indie-folk with a punch. Plus several Rising Stars (young local performers).
​ Deep inside the Milky Way Glowworm Cave is the Starburst Cathedral, the largest chamber of the cave, filled with delicate crystal formations and thousands of star-like glowworms. Here the mix of music, the unique acoustics of the cave chamber, the sound of dripping water, the absolutely enchanting beauty of this subterranean world provides you with a magical experience of a lifetime.
​ ​​​
​The Milky Way Glowworm Cave is a Jewel of Northland. The privately owned cave was opened for public viewing in early 2023 after being kept secret for over 100 years. The cave required a lot of development over 5 years to make it a walk-in show-cave. It has rapidly become world famous for its quality of stalactites and glowworms which draws visitors from around the world. The Starburst Cathedral is the largest chamber, 250m into the Milky Way Glowworm Cave. This chamber is the most spectacular display of delicate straws and stalactites, 10s and 100s of thousands of years old. It is an awe inspiring place with wonderful acoustics.
​
Artists & Music Genre
Each Concert has a different genre of music, including opera, classical music, folk, soft rock, pop, country, bluegrass, with instruments strings, wood and wind, electric piano, violins, pipes, guitars, base, cello and box drum. ​
The Cave Concert has 2 halves with a main performer each half, plus young performers we call Rising Stars. ​
​
Important
Make sure you select the correct Cave Concert date when booking. Use the calendar after clicking the button below.
​
Buy Cave Concert Tickets
December 19th - Saturday - Sunny Ray a local singer song writer. Nat Torkington & Jenine Abarbanel (AKA The Minimal Viable Band) perform eclectic acoustic folk on banjo and guitar. Plus several Rising Stars (young local performers).
January 16th - Saturday - Tammy D'Ath (Tammy Lee Cook). Miho's Jazz Orchestra a fun packed jazz fusion group. Plus several Rising Stars (young local performers).
February 13th - Saturday - Nathan Boston (part of White Chapel Jack) & Mema (Vaimoana) Wilda. Charlotte Rockstar Jones with a vast variety from old rock to new. Plus several Rising Stars (young local performers).
March 13th - Saturday - White Chapel Jack for the whole show. Plus a few Rising Stars.
April 10th - Saturday - Opera North for the whole show, with a mix instruments, soloist, choral singing plus Rising Stars.
Down to Vidoes
Ticket info
This page edited by Ian Fox 4th September.
Back to Top
Down to Vidoes
​​ Time & Program - 6pm start.
6:00pm - Guests arrive to the car park at Waipu Caves Farm Park and check in at the office. (Those who have some difficulty walking can park closer to the cave after check in). Guests will be guided in groups of 10-15 people into the Milky Way Glowworm Cave, all the way down to the Starburst Cathedral at 250m inside the cave. On entry into the cave guests are provided a small hand light.
6:50pm - Once all are seated a welcoming speech.
6.55pm - First half Rising Stars (young performers).
7:15pm - First half Main Performer.
7:45pm - A 40 minute break with light finger food snack (provided) in the Milky Way Chamber (half way back to the cave entry point), a toilet stop (outside the cave), and a little time to look around the cave.
8:25pm - Second half Rising Stars (young performers).
8:40pm - Second half Main Performer.
9:20pm - Closing speech and Thanks.
9:25pm - Guests guided out in groups. On exiting guest hold lights low so they can see glowworms all the way out of the Milky Way Glowworm Cave.
10:00pm - Last of the guest should be exiting around 10:00pm. ​ ​ ​
​
Tickets & Pricing
Due to it's location there is limited seating for only 75 people.
The concert is not suitable for children. It is for age 16 and upwards.
Concert Tickets are $150 each. This price is due to the unique location and the limited guest numbers.
Tickets are only sold on our website. They are not on other ticketing platforms.
Each seat is provided with a fleece blanket to either sit on or wrap over your shoulders.
(Separate to this concert the cave tour into Starburst Cathedral for 1.5 hours is $80 or the shorter tour half way in is $45).
​ ​
Filming Disclosure
The Cave Concerts are professionally filmed for marketing. As this is a small venue you may end up on film.
​
Age Restriction
The concert is not suitable for children. It is for age 16 and upwards. If a younger person is in serious training for being a musical performer we will make an exception. Please email about this.
​
Event Start and Finish
You must arrive by 6pm, so you can be guided inside the Milky Way Glowworm Cave to the Starburst Cathedral, 250m inside the cave. This will take time, and there will be a cutoff time for guides to get you into the cave for the last people seating by 6.45pm and the start at 6.55pm.
Phones & Photos
There is no cell phone coverage or Wi-Fi underground. You may take photos (flash turned off) of the cave and glowworms, before or after the concert.
You are not allowed to take photos or video during the musical part of the event.
Toilets
There are no toilets in the cave. The toilet is outside the cave which is a 250m walk to get outside plus 50m outside to flushing portaloos.
There are toilets at the office also, which we recommend you use before walking 300m over to the cave entrance.
Sensible Clothing & Footwear
The walk to the cave is a gravel path and inside the cave is a concrete path with 30 steeps down into the cave. You need to wear sensible footwear like sneakers/trainers. DON'T WEAR HIGH HEELS OR PLATFORMS. The cave temperature is about 12-15 degrees Celsius so you need to wear sensible warm clothing such as a jacket. DON'T WEAR A LIGHT SUMMER DRESS.
Food
You should eat dinner before you come
